resources.string: Microphone permission was not granted. You can allow it in Android app settings.
The small punctuation model is not included in this build. Android punctuation is available on supported devices. Changes apply to the next voice session.

The small model is included in this test build. It revisits text across pauses, independently of AI cleanup. Android punctuation is not requested in this mode. Sentence endings stay provisional while listening and can change as more words arrive. The model can still miss or add punctuation. Fast formatting can also correct its capitalization. Select Android to compare, or no punctuation pass to disable both. Changes apply next session. Undo disables the small model for the session.

Ask on-device speech recognition to add punctuation and capitals as you dictate, prioritizing speed. Works with AI cleanup off; no extra model download. Some recognizers ignore this request. Changes apply to the next voice session. Turn off to compare. Undo keeps the punctuation returned by Android.
Android punctuation: requested, prioritizing speed. Device support is not confirmed.

Immediately lowercases mid-sentence words unless their capitals are protected. A pause or new recognition segment does not start a sentence. Keeps clear sentence starts, I, acronyms, mixed-case names, quoted text and words in Protected capitals. Add other names there to keep their capitals. Also fixes comma spacing and checks AI results. Works with AI cleanup off. Undo restores raw recognition and disables both passes for this session.
Fast formatting: on. Mid-sentence capitals and comma spacing are corrected immediately, with protected-word exceptions.

Keep the existing capitals in these words during fast formatting. Use one word per line; for a name with several words, add each word. Possessives are protected too. Add people, places or products you use. Remove an entry to let it be lowercased mid-sentence. An empty list is allowed. I, acronyms, mixed-case names and quoted text are protected automatically. AI cleanup can still edit the wording. Save applies to the next voice session. Maximum %1$d characters.
Fast formatting: off or unavailable for this language.
The local model is editing your finalized dictation, including earlier utterances. Keep speaking.
AI cleanup failed or exceeded the model budget. Current text is kept.
Speech service did not become ready. Tap Resume to retry.
Local voice typing requires Android 12 or later.
No on-device speech recognizer is installed. There is no cloud fallback.
Open Models / setup to allow microphone access, then return to voice typing.
This speech language is not available locally. Install it in your speech provider settings, then retry.
The speech recognizer is busy. Try again shortly.
Local recognition failed. Check microphone access and installed speech languages.
Voice typing is unavailable in password fields or without a text editor.
Download a cleanup model in Models / setup. Speech still works without one.

Speech and cleanup run on this device. Internet is used only when you choose to download a model from Hugging Face. Audio and transcripts are never automatically uploaded. Optional diagnostic recording saves audio and text locally for explicit export. Automatic cleanup edits dictated words, not instructions into messages; review your text before sending. Install speech languages through your Android speech provider if needed.
This build includes voice typing only. Build with -PvoiceLlm=true to enable local model cleanup.
Local model available. Return to your text field to start voice typing.
Import failed. Choose a compatible GGUF under 2 GiB and check available storage.
Type any key to leave dictation. Tap or hold an icon for its status or action.
Cleanup applied. Undo restores the dictated words and turns off automatic cleanup.
Cleanup looked unreliable. Dictated words kept.
Allow twice the model size in free storage during installation. Downloads continue if you leave; reopen this screen to finish verifying and activating them.
1.12 GB · More capacity for cleanup; slower and uses more memory. Apache 2.0 license.
491 MB · Faster and smaller; less reliable at complex cleanup. Apache 2.0 license.
Download or verification failed. Existing model kept. Check storage and connection, then try again.
Download queued or waiting for a connection (Wi-Fi if selected)…
Model verified and selected. Return to your text field to use voice typing.
Could not remove the model. Try again after cleanup finishes.
Automatic cleanup on — tap to turn off
Automatic cleanup off — tap to turn on
This speech provider did not accept continuous audio. Using compatibility mode; pauses may still cause gaps.

Configure the microphone in suggestion bar or ?123 menu settings. Chords and edge swipes offer Voice typing alongside Paste and Copy. Enter :voice_typing in an Enter, letter or punctuation alternate list. Comma and period keys also offer Voice typing in Size and layout settings.

Keeps a local microphone stream open until you pause or type. Turn off if your speech provider cannot handle it. Compatibility mode restarts recognition between utterances. Tap the microphone in the voice toolbar to check the active mode.
Microphone shortcuts, continuous dictation and local cleanup models
Compatibility mode — gaps between utterances are possible
Choose a preset or edit the instructions, then tap Save. Your transcript is appended automatically. Maximum %1$d characters. Cleanup checks may keep the original text when edits change too much.
Cleanup queued. Keep speaking. Typing or leaving voice mode cancels pending cleanup.
AI cleanup timed out. Current text is kept. Tap the status for details and Retry. Speech recognition can continue.
Cleanup reached its input or output limit. Current text is kept. See details; a shorter session may help.
Cleanup job %1$d is processing revision %2$d (%3$d s). Latest speech revision: %4$d. You can keep speaking.
Last applied revision: %1$d. Latest speech revision: %2$d.

Opt-in diagnostic recording saves microphone audio, recognized words, model instructions and results, nearby editor context, and text updates on this device. Enable this, return to a text field, and reproduce the problem. REC in the toolbar means capture is active. Tap the status for Mark problem or Stop recording. Typing ends the session. Continuous audio mode is needed to capture audio; compatibility gaps are marked. Capture stops at 10 minutes or 64 MB. Only the newest 3 sessions are kept, outside Android backup. Export a ZIP only when you choose to share it; recordings may contain private conversations and text.
Diagnostic recording active (audio and text). Status: %1$s
Diagnostic recording stopped: %1$s. Export from Voice diagnostics.
A diagnostic session is still recording or finishing.
Export a completed report below. The ZIP contains audio and text.
Problem marker saved. Diagnostic recording continues.
Report exported. Share the ZIP when ready.
Export failed. The local recording is still available.
Android reported low memory. The cleanup model was released. Speech can continue; Retry will reload the model.
